data.retirementBeneficiary: 山东世纪阳光纸业集团有限公司Shandong Century Sunshine Paper Group Co., Ltd.
data.retirementDetails: 经BSI第三方核查，山东世纪阳光纸业集团有限公司200gsm涂布白面牛卡纸产品的碳足迹为1.16 t CO2e/t。2024年第一季度，公司使用IREC后的产品碳足迹为0.608 t CO2e/t。山东世纪阳光纸业集团有限公司自愿抵消7680 t VCUs，实现2024年第一季度 生产的12508批次合计12646.101 t“200gsm涂布白面牛卡纸”产品的碳中和。这些产品用于百威包装箱生产。相关工作基于ISO 14067:2018和PAS 2060:2014标准，并通过第BSI三方核查。 Verified by BSI as a third party, the carbon footprint of 200gsm Coated WTTL from Shandong Century Sunshine Paper Group Co., Ltd. is 1.16 t CO2e/t. In the first quarter of 2024, the company's product carbon footprint after using IREC was 0.608 t CO2e/t.  Shandong Century Sunshine Paper Group Co., Ltd. voluntarily offset 7680 tons of VCUs to achieve carbon neutrality of the 12508 batches of "200gsm coated white kraft cardboard" products produced in the first quarter of 2024, totaling 12646.101 tons. These products are used in the production of Budweiser packaging boxes. The relevant work is based on ISO 14067:2018 and PAS 2060:2014 standards, and has been verified by BSI.
